title: EAFIX Secondary Name Matches Requiring Ownership Investigation
purpose: List the secondary filename/path matches that are related to canonical modules but are not safe to move until content, imports, tests, runtime use, and ownership are validated.

summary.note: The prior total of 168 is a count of file-to-module relationship records, not 168 unique files. These records represent 86 distinct source files; some files are candidates for more than one module.

investigation_priority_definition.priority_1: Implementation source with multiple module candidates or import/reference risk.
investigation_priority_definition.priority_2: Implementation source or test requiring content and dependency tracing.
investigation_priority_definition.priority_3: Contract, schema, work-cell, or stronger non-code relationship requiring ownership analysis.
investigation_priority_definition.priority_4: Documentation or metadata relationship requiring lower-priority review.
